package zztrust

import "github.com/polarisagi/polaris/internal/security/policy"

type mockPolicyHolder struct {
	Profile policy.TrustProfile
}

func selftestTrustProfileSelector(h mockPolicyHolder) bool {
	// 负向用例：对 .Profile 字段比较 policy.ProfileHardened（R3-08 门控盲区形态）
	return h.Profile == policy.ProfileHardened
}
